svg.title: coderprint: 703k lines of code in use, of 1.5M written, all time
svg.desc: 703,498 lines of code in use (470,924 in production, 232,574 in tests), of 1,532,418 written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 3,821 commits across all branches, 69 active days, a longest streak of 40 days, a current streak of 14 days, and 6 languages at 1% or more of the lines of code. They came in 3 bursts of 19k, 56k and 1.5M lines of code. The bars end on 31OCT2026, the day this panel was drawn. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 61%, Lean 18%, Python 12%, TypeScript 5%, JavaScript 3%, Shell 1%, other languages under 1%. Of what was written, 46% is kept.
